title: Filipino Kaldereta Chicken
description: A classic Filipino dish made with tender chicken in a rich tomato-based sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add canned or chopped fresh tomatoes and cook until they start to break down.
Add kaldereta sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot garnished with chopped green onions or fresh cilantro if desired.
